customers_say: Customers find the smart lock to be of good quality and worth its price, with straightforward installation and reliable performance. They appreciate its comprehensive features and ease of use, and one customer specifically mentions the anti-pry/tamper alarm as an added security feature. Customers like its appearance, with one noting it looks good on the door.

reviews.author: Vadehra Priyanka
reviews.title: Excellent product and great service
reviews.body: I’m very happy with my experience with the Lavna Smart Door Lock. The lock looks sleek, feels secure, and works smoothly. The installation process was quick and hassle-free. A special mention to Lucky, the technician, who was extremely professional, polite, and knowledgeable. He explained everything clearly, installed the lock perfectly, and made sure all the features were working properly before leaving. Overall, excellent product and excellent service. Highly recommended! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

reviews.title: After sale support is effective
reviews.body: The after sale support team is really halpful, I had issues after installation related to the setup. Jatin (support executive) trouble shooted all the problems and helped me resolve the same within few minutes. The lock looks steady and good.

reviews.author: Amazon Customer
reviews.title: Solid smart lock, a few rough edges
reviews.body: Been using the LAVNA smart lock on my main wooden door for a while now. Installation was straightforward and the fingerprint sensor is genuinely fast and accurate. Having the built-in camera plus RFID card, PIN, and manual key backup means I’m never locked out even if the battery dies or the app acts up. What I like: • Fingerprint unlock is near-instant • App notifications when someone unlocks the door — good peace of mind • Anti-pry/tamper alarm adds real security • Manual key backup as a fail-safe What could improve: • App settings menu isn’t very intuitive — took some digging to find and ad

reviews.author: Aditya Parulkar
reviews.title: Great product! Value for money
reviews.body: Loving the product! It is very stylish, sleek and has great functions. Installation was set up very efficiently and done very smoothly. Tejeshwar Maharana is very knowledgable and skilled. He helped set up the app and explained all the functionality very well.
